hook: Your brain is 2% of your weight and burns a fifth of your energy.
twist: It runs on about 12 watts, a fifth of an old 60-watt bulb, and hard thinking barely adds to the bill: most of the cost is staying switched on. So the 'you only use 10%' myth is backwards: you pay for all of it, all the time.
angle: The Brain brags, the Heart complains about deliveries, a light bulb glows at 12 W, and the myth gets stamped. Big number: 12 watts.
why_now: Scout: brain-facts Shorts top 80.9M, median of top 25 6.4M since mid-2024.
risks: 12 W is Scientific American's worked estimate from a 1,300 kcal resting rate; label it.
